Name: Seed Scatter
Author: DarkRobon
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Seed Scatter[/b][/size]
[size=3]Hold. Charge. Scatter.[/size]
Unlock larger planting and fertilizing patterns as your farming skill grows.
[/center]

Equip your seeds or fertilizer, hold your usual Use Tool or Action button, and watch the highlighted area expand through your unlocked patterns. Release to apply your held stack. Farming progression is enabled by default; the original centered scatter mode is still available as an option.

Your farmer slows down while charging, holds a small animated wind-up pose, and finishes with a directional hand sweep. Wait for the throw to finish before starting another scatter, just like using a tool.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Grow with your farming skill.[/b] Start with ordinary single-tile placement and unlock 1x3, 1x5, 3x3, 3x6, and 5x5 patterns at Farming 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10.[/*]
[*][b]Choose your mode.[/b] Keep progression enabled or switch to the original centered 3x3/5x5 mode through Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.[/*]
[*][b]Seeds and fertilizer.[/b] Use the same controls for planting crops and applying fertilizer, including to existing crops when that fertilizer allows it.[/*]
[*][b]See your targets.[/b] Colored highlights show the placement preview and which tiles your current stack can cover.[/*]
[*][b]Move while charging.[/b] Reposition at a slower, tool-charging pace; the area follows your farmer.[/*]
[*][b]Farmer animations.[/b] A subtle charging bob and a hand sweep in all four directions use the game's existing farmer sprites.[/*]
[*][b]Partial stacks work.[/b] If you have fewer items than available spaces, the closest eligible tiles are filled first.[/*]
[*][b]Pay for successful placement only.[/b] Each successful application uses one item. Rejected applications do not spend items.[/*]
[*][b]Modded materials.[/b] Seeds and fertilizers registered through the normal game item system should work automatically, with no item ID list to configure.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable charge times.[/b] Change the progression charge interval, original-mode thresholds, and charge sounds in Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Select a stack of crop seeds or fertilizer in your hotbar.[/*]
[*]Hold your normal [b]Use Tool[/b] or [b]Action[/b] button. The mod follows your in-game bindings, including controller bindings.[/*]
[*]Hold to advance through your unlocked patterns, one stage every [b]0.5 seconds[/b] by default. Charging stops at your farming level's maximum.[/*]
[*]Move into position if needed, then release the button to scatter.[/*]
[*]Let the throwing animation finish before starting again. Presses during the throw are not queued.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Quick placement:[/b] At Farming 0-1, the game keeps its ordinary single-tile planting and fertilizing behavior. Once charging is unlocked, release before the first charge threshold to attempt a single placement using normal targeting and reach.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Farming progression — enabled by default[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Farming 0-1:[/b] One tile at a time, with normal game controls.[/*]
[*][b]Farming 2-3:[/b] Up to [b]1x3[/b], reached at 0.5 seconds.[/*]
[*][b]Farming 4-5:[/b] Up to [b]1x5[/b], reached at 1 second.[/*]
[*][b]Farming 6-7:[/b] Up to [b]3x3[/b], reached at 1.5 seconds.[/*]
[*][b]Farming 8-9:[/b] Up to [b]3x6[/b], reached at 2 seconds.[/*]
[*][b]Farming 10+:[/b] Up to [b]5x5[/b], reached at 2.5 seconds.[/*]
[/list]Times above use the default charge interval. You can release at an earlier unlocked stage to use a smaller pattern. Charged patterns extend from the tile immediately in front of your farmer, matching tool footprints, and rotate with your facing direction. Unlocks use your permanent farming level; food and temporary skill bonuses do not unlock tiers. The progression applies to both seeds and fertilizer.

[b]Prefer the original behavior?[/b] In Generic Mod Config Menu, open Seed Scatter, turn off [b]Use farming progression[/b], and save. Original mode makes centered [b]3x3[/b] and [b]5x5[/b] areas available at every farming level, reached at 0.5 and 1 second by default. You can also set [b]UseProgression[/b] to [b]false[/b] in config.json. Resetting settings restores progression mode.

[b]Cancel a charge:[/b] Press Escape or controller B, open a menu, change the selected item or hotbar slot, or leave the location. Losing focus, saving, and the end of the day also cancel charging.

[b]Preview colors[/b]
[list]
[*][color=#66CC66]Green:[/color] Your held stack has an item allocated to this tile.[/*]
[*][color=#E6B84D]Gold:[/color] The placement preview accepts this tile, but your held stack does not have enough items to cover it.[/*]
[*][color=#DD7777]Red:[/color] The placement preview rejects this tile.[/*]
[/list]The game and other mods may apply additional rules when you release the button. A previewed tile can still be rejected by the final placement check; that rejection does not spend an item.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]What can be scattered?[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Crop seeds:[/b] Plant on eligible empty tilled soil. Seed Scatter does not till, water, harvest, or replace existing crops. Season and location restrictions still apply.

[b]Fertilizer:[/b] Apply to eligible targets using that item's normal rules. Existing crops can receive fertilizer when its type and the crop's growth stage allow it. Garden pots and tree fertilizer follow their ordinary placement behavior.

Only the selected stack is used. The mod does not pull extra items from other inventory slots or chests, and it does not mix seed or fertilizer types.

Saplings and wild tree seeds keep their normal planting behavior. Charging is unavailable while seated, mounted, or unable to act normally.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.3.2 or newer[/b].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is [b]optional[/b] for editing settings in game.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you have not already.[/*]
[*]Download the main file and extract the [b]SeedScatter[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The installed folder should contain SeedScatter.dll, manifest.json, and the i18n folder. The first launch creates config.json automatically.

[b]Updating:[/b] Close the game and replace the files in your existing SeedScatter folder with the new download. Keep your config.json if you want to retain your settings.

[b]Uninstalling:[/b] Close the game and remove the SeedScatter folder from Mods. Crops and fertilizer already applied remain ordinary game crops and fertilizer.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, open its [b]Seed Scatter[/b] entry, change your settings, and save. Changes apply without restarting. You can also launch the mod once, close the game, and edit [b]Mods/SeedScatter/config.json[/b] in a text editor.

[code]{
  "UseProgression": true,
  "ProgressionChargeMilliseconds": 500,
  "ThreeByThreeChargeMilliseconds": 500,
  "FiveByFiveChargeMilliseconds": 1000,
  "PlayChargeSounds": true
}[/code][list]
[*][b]UseProgression:[/b] true enables farming-level unlocks; false restores the original centered mode. Default: true.[/*]
[*][b]ProgressionChargeMilliseconds:[/b] Time spent charging each progression stage. Default: 500 milliseconds. Only affects progression mode.[/*]
[*][b]ThreeByThreeChargeMilliseconds:[/b] Time needed to reach centered 3x3 in original mode. Default: 500 milliseconds.[/*]
[*][b]FiveByFiveChargeMilliseconds:[/b] Total time needed to reach centered 5x5 in original mode. Default: 1000 milliseconds.[/*]
[*][b]PlayChargeSounds:[/b] Play a charge sound when the area expands. Default: true. Set to false to disable those cues.[/*]
[/list]One second is 1000 milliseconds. Keep the original-mode 5x5 threshold higher than its 3x3 threshold. Existing configs without the new mode setting default to progression when updated.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
Seed Scatter uses the original held item and its normal placement checks and actions. Data-registered modded crop seeds and fertilizers should work automatically, and custom item metadata is kept the same.

Mods that implement planting through custom tools, unrelated item categories, or separate interactions may need an explicit integration. Mods that change input, movement, or farmer animation behavior can also affect the experience. There is no blanket guarantee for every mod combination.

The animations use the normal farmer renderer, so ordinary replacements for the farmer's textures, clothes, and appearance can continue to use their own assets. Animation overhauls that change the meaning or layout of farmer frames may need compatibility work.

[b]Multiplayer and split-screen:[/b] Separate local charge states are implemented, and placement uses the game's normal networked objects. Co-op and split-screen have not yet received live in-game verification.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Do I need to buy a new tool or upgrade my hoe?[/b]
No new tool is required. Hold an ordinary stack of crop seeds or fertilizer. In the default progression mode, larger patterns unlock at Farming 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Switch progression off if you want the original centered areas available at any farming level.

[b]What happens if I run out halfway through?[/b]
The mod stops when the held stack runs out. It uses the closest eligible tiles first and leaves the remaining spaces alone.

[b]Can I hold the button to keep repeating?[/b]
Each scatter needs a hold and release. Another use cannot begin until the throw's final frame finishes. Input during that animation is not queued.

[b]Why did a highlighted tile not get planted or fertilized?[/b]
The preview uses the game's usual item placement preview. Final season, location, fertilizer, or mod-specific rules can still reject a placement when you release. Rejected placements do not consume items.

[b]Does this change crop growth or fertilizer strength?[/b]
No. It changes how you apply the held items. Their normal growth and fertilizer effects remain in place.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Bug reports[/b][/size][/color]
Please include your Stardew Valley version, Seed Scatter version, a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url], the item you were holding, and the steps needed to reproduce the issue. For a modded item, include the mod that adds it. For control issues, mention whether you used a mouse, keyboard, or controller.

[size=4][b][color=#ff7700]Credits[/color][/b][/size]
Built with SMAPI and the game's existing farmer animation frames.
